batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b DW Steyn

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b A Mishra

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: run out (AB de Villiers, KD Karthik)

batting.name: MV Boucher
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b PJ Sangwan

batting.name: P Kumar
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b UT Yadav

balls.text: high fulltoss outside off and McD misses it, as it runs through to Boucher.
fifty for Jadhav on IPL debut! What an innings, stayed back and guided the slower ball to the left of point
wallop! Slower ball outside off, Jadhav made all the pace, running down the track, picking it up and going straight down the ground.
good shot! Over-pitched on off stump, Jadhav was on his knees and waiting, worked it away with a sweep-shot through square leg
tight call, really slow ball 85.6 kph, that's slower than Kumble! It slipped marginally down the leg and umpire Jerling did not call it wide
slow bouncer, at 101 kph, McDonald did well to make contact, he had started playing the shot months before the ball got to him
short and wide outside off, Jadhav stays back, makes room and slaps it high over cover, it lands safe and Kallis, at sweeper cover, cleans up.
short but not short enough to pull, and Jadhav barely gets it over mid on
unlucky for the bowler! Attempted yorker became a fulltoss since Jadhav was coming down the track and his thick edge went very fine for four
makes room and works it though the offside this time
that's a big Mac, Maharaja Mac as they call it in India! Length ball, drifting down the leg and McDonald stayed back and lifted it high over midwicket
back of the hand slower ball, McD gets down the track and works it away towards wide long off, and scurries back for two
full and wide, swings away and goes wider.
yorker at 149.3 kph, McD made room and tried to use the pace, but could only get it away to cover for one
short and wide outside off, and he gets a thickish edge very fine and high. On the bounce to third man
Steyn-gun goes wide again, well outside off
flicked away well, but straight to midwicket
good hit! Cleared the front foot and launched the length ball wide of long off, where the fielder put in a desperate dive but could not save four
nice bit of fielding by Pandey at the deep cover boundary. McDonald got it away over the infield, off the backfoot and Pandey put in a dive to save a run
educated edge from McDonald to get off the mark. It was fast outside off, he made room and got a thick outside edge, wide of Boucher
Jadhav walks down and shovels the length ball over cover for a couple
starts from outside off and swings away for an easy call of wide
follows the batsman as he moves towards the legside, and cramps him up for room.
clever slow bouncer this time and decieves the batsman, who in the end plays no shot
leg-cutter this time, on middle and off, plays it away to the offside and Morgan does not field cleanly this time
jags back in from short of a length, pegs McDonald back in the crease
slips down the legside for a wide

Pandemonium! Nice yorker from Praveen, he digs it out behind square on the offside and runs for a tight single. Morgan fires a superb throw, that possibly caught the batsman short, RCB's fielders surely thought so and were celebrating. The ball ricocheted, and was going for runs, Kumble was furious that his side was celebrating without tidying up, before Kohli said he thought it was out. And he was right, the third umpire thought so too. AB's gone!
works it away to the leg side this time for a single. Jadhav's looking good.

shot of the day, mis-field of the day and priceless expression of the day all in one! Nicely played off the stumps, delicate little late cut, that Rahul Dravid misfields at short third man. Kumble gives him a glare that could melt solid gold! Dravid chases and tidies up, keeps it down to two.
gets it away this time, down to midwicket
lovely ball, holds it back and AB is early in to the length, gets a leading edge back to the bowler
down the track and goes for the loft over long on, but does not time it too well. One bounce to long off
length ball on leg stump, stays back and punches it through the midwicket region
good short ball this time, very well directed and Jadhav was late on the shot. Carries through to Boucher
swing and a miss outside off this time

and he squeezes it over long off's head for a six! Jadhav was at it again, walking down the track, Kallis saw him coming and banged it in short, but he had the guts to go through with the pull shot and it went over long off. Uthappa waited and jumped at long off, but it was inches over his fingers
full outside off, AB gets forward and drives it straight to deep cover
short of a length outside off, he opens up the offside and whips it through the covers
slower ball, sliding on to middle and leg and beautifully picked up! Jadhav came down a pace, went down on a knee and lapped it up behind square leg for four
on to his pads this time, and Jadhav works it away easily to the legside.
great shot and even better fielding. Picks the slider outside off and expertly works it to the left of Uthappa at point, but he puts in some big strides to cut off some runs
again on the pads and AB works it away this time. He's clearly biding his time for a late assault. I think.
drifts on to his pads, stays back and works it down to square leg
short outside off, cut away for a single
slower ball again, short of a length, AB waited on it and guided it through the covers for one
worked down to third man for one
nice shot! Tries the short ball this time, Jadhav hit it well, if somewhat late and the forehand crosscourt winner went straight, to the left of and over mid off
another slower ball, Bangalore seem to have replaced the short ball strategy with the slower ball strategy today. Gets forward and drives down the ground.
straighter this time, allows Jadhav to work it away to square leg.
short and just outside off, looks to cut it away, can't find the gap
short ball, drifts down the legside and misses the attempted pull. Bangalore go up in a loud appeal. Umpire Rudi languorously raises his arms to signal wide
full outside off, new-comer Kedar Jadhav gets forward and drives square to get off the mark.
played away to cover to turn the strike over

no escape this time! Poor Karthik got no chance to capitalise on that reprieve, AB essays the most straight straight-drive you'll ever see and it was too straight for Karthik's good. Steyn got a finger on that on his follow through and it crashed on to the non-striker's end stumps. DK was well out and kept going.
pacy this time! Pegs him back with a short, fast ball, DK hits it straight to Kohli at point and runs for a non-existent single. Kohli misses the direct hit, it would have been curtains.
lovely slower delivery, runs his fingers over that one and beats Karthik's outside edge as he walks down the track
quick length ball on off stump, played away off front foot to short cover
low fulltoss on offstump, but Karthik is unable to make much use of it and drives it down to long off to retain strike
another off cutter from Kallis, he stays back and works it away to midwicket
wider outside off, and this time AB can't get it away past point. Rare dot ball
and again - 111.5 kph. Karthik works it away to midwicket
another slower ball, cleverly done. Saw AB coming down the track and pulled it back a touch. Still gets it down to long on for one.
length ball on off stump, worked away easily down to long on
another slower ball, 101.3 kph, AB nudges it down with soft hands to the legside and they run like men possessed for two. Great running.
slower ball, yorker on middle and leg off the back of the hand. DK picks it and gets it away to mid on
drifts on to the pads this time, and he plays it away wide of midwicket
draws him forward, batsman obliges and eases it off the front foot to wide mid off
short of a length again and DK premeditates the sashay down the track. Still can't get to the length of the ball and can't get it away for many through the legside
short and wide outside off, DK lets it go and it is called wide
short of a length, and cramps him for room, angling it into AB, who stays back and taps it to short midwicket. Lots of singles in this partnership
pulls out an inch-perfect sweep shot. It was full outside off, but DK was eyeing the gap between square leg and deep midwicket, he got down on one knee and bisected the gap to perfection. Nice shot
punched down to wide long on where Kohli cleans up

full outside DK's offstump and he again stays back to work it down to third man. They complete a risky single, AB makes it to the striker's end in time. DK might have been in toruble at the other end.
on to AB's pads, he gets forward and easily works it away for one.
slightly fuller this time, DK stays back and runs it down to short third man
conventional Kumble length leggie, gets forward and drives it towards the covers
another back of the hand slower ball, very full on middle and off, gets forward and drives it down to wide long off
oooh, he's yet to get used to this pitch for sure. Very early into that flick, it takes the leading edge and somehow eludes all the offside fielders
full outside off, DK gets forward and plays a half-hearted check-drive, it is cut off by short cover.
effort ball, short outside off, he lets it go.
back of the hand slower delivery, at 104.8 kph. AB stays back and taps it down to the leg side to rotate strike.
short of a length, drifts on to Karthik's pads. Stays back and works it away behind square.
short and well wide outside off stump, but it looked like AB had picked his spot much earlier. Swats it down off the backfoot, through midwicket. Nice shot, it raced away
full on middle, gets forward and works it away with the wrists
short of a length, outside off, gets back and works it away to midwicket. No turn here for Jumbo.

drifts on to the pads, he stays back and works it away to square leg, where Steyn picks up and fires a great throw, but it misses the stumps by a whisker, giving AB enough time to get in, before Boucher can collect and break the stumps. Third umpire says not out
slightly outside off this time, AB comes forward and drives it through the covers
loopy legspinner on middle and off, gets forward and drives along the round through covers
edged, but safe. Short lifter outside off, and the airy backfoot drive went through the obviously vacant gully area, down to third man
full on off and middle, AB gets forward and punches it down to long on
slightly wider and AB capitalises, gets some power into his cover drive and Morgan nearly cuts it off, running across from point, but it beats him
short of a length again, and angling in to AB, defended off the back foot
short of a length, outside off. Defended safely

and he strikes first ball!!! Vinay's golden arm works yet again, length ball outside off, Sehwag goes for the almighty carve over cover, but it goes high rather that far. Kohli runs behind, makes a lot of room and very nearly collides with Morgan who was converging, but Kohli completes the catch in the end. Not much calling there for sure, but Aal izz well for Bangalore. Big wicket!
slower ball again, Sehwag picks it this time, waits on it and runs it delicately down to third man to take a single and retain strike
slower ball, AB picks it, gets forward and flicks it down to short midwicket for a quick one
fuller this time, draws AB forward and he essays the cover drive where an alert Manish Pandey dives away to his right to save a couple
don't try the short stuff with me, AB seemed to say, as he got on to his toes and pull-slap-swatted that down from outside off to midwicket. Nicely played
fuller, drifting on to AB's pads he gets forward and flicks it to square leg for two more
short of a length, AB jumps out and guides it down to deep square leg and comes back for the second
short of a length outside off, Sehwag gets back nicely and punches it, but can't get past cover
length ball on off stump, pushed nicely through covers by AB. They run two and then Steyn tries to be cheeky, deflecting the return throw, which only goes away for an over throw
145.9 kph, similar length, Sehwag makes contact this time and it runs down to third man
finally a length ball and Sehwag's eyes lit up, but he could not connect with the attempted cover drive

and that's the end of Warner! Again short of a length, and Warner cleares his front foot and looks to go over the off side boundary, does not time it very well and it skies to long off, where Vinay does well running to his left, taking it a couple of feet in front of the ropes
fulltoss on offstump, Warner had no problems dealing with it. Stays back and punches it through the covers. Delhi are off to a scorcher!
Steyn's radar lost signal momentarily, that flew out of his hand, very wide outside off

slow and steady does not always win the race! Short ball outside off at 109 kph, Sehwag makes room by moving to the leg side, goes has a chai and comes back to lap it up and over, above the head of point for four
another short ball, this time at good pace by Praveen standards - 124.9 kph. Sehwag can't connect with the pull
short, on middle and leg and Warner pulls it away easily this time
short again, makes room and goes over mid off, Uthappa makes a mess of it at the long off boundary to give away four

slower ball again, and he very nearly has his man. That was short and so slow, Warner must be feeling very confused with the changes in pace, he nicks the pull, and it probably fell just short of Boucher
slower ball from the much slower Praveen Kumar. 113 kph, Sehwag waits and works it off his hips behind quare on the leg side

whoop! He's had a couple of sighters at Steyn's express fast short ball and has finally recalibrated the speed of his bat swing to hit it on time, and boy was that timed! Flies over midwicket for another six
145.9 kph, back on to off stump line, and short of a length. Sehwag steers off the backfoot in front of point
and he's away this time! 144.4 kph, but drifting onto Sehwag's pads, he gets inside the line and flicks it away easily behind square.
149 kph, and respect from Sehwag. Stays back and check-drives the short of length delivery to the offside
short of a length again, 142.2 kph and again, it's on to Warner very quickly.. This time, he's fractionally earlier on to it, and it goes down to mid on.
ha! Real pace this time, so much so that Warner is so late on the pull, that it races away to the cover boundary for four!
shortens the length and straightens the line a touch, played away to the leg side for a run.

and he finally gets hold on one! Praveen's not getting much movement, and at his pace, the length offerings are going to go for runs some day. It could be today, Warner made good contact and whacked it high over long on.
tucks him up on leg and middle, quietly played off the back foot into the leg side

slower ball, this time dropped by Uthappa! Decieves Warner, who is early into the shot and scoops it high over mid off. Uthappa runs back several yards and gets there, but puts it down as it comes over his shoulder. Harsh call, but that is a drop.
length again, this time Warner goes aerial, but does not time it too well. Uthappa is in business again, runs it down to the boundary and saves two more!
length ball on middle and off, whacked by Warner wide of Uthappa at mid off who puts in the dive and saves a couple. Good stuff!
and it's all ova! Kumble can't do much with that short of a length ball outside off and gets it away to cover for a single. Bangalore have fallen well short today.
McDonald's done in Steyn with a nice straight yorker! Steyn goes for an almighty heave over the leg side, but cannot make contact and the stumps are shattered
shortens the length, outside off, Kohli slaps it down to long off for one
Kohli's not finished! Fulltoss on his pads, he got under it and mowed it over cow corner
gets under the overpitched ball on leg stump and gets it down between long on and deep midwicket. Great placement.
good yorker, full on leg stump, and he can only drive down the ground to long on
yorker outside off, tries to dig it out and cannot make contact
very low fulltoss on leg stump, Steyn drives down the ground for one
fortune favours the Steyn! length ball on middle and leg, Steyn shuffles all over the place and plays a pull that runs down to fine leg off the inside edge
makes room by moving to the leg side and drills it straight to long off
fulltoss on middle and Kohli cashes in. He manages to get it away through midwicket. They need a lot more of that
full on middle and off, played away to the offside
length ball, stays back and plays it through the covers
short and wide outside off, misses Steyn's swat, there was a definite edge to Karthik, but umpire Jerling missed it.
on leg stump this time, and Kallis can't get it away
slips down the leg and Steyn gets something on it down to fine leg

AB de Villiers has taken the catch of the tournament! Short of a length, Praveen played the pull, and very nearly got it over AB at long off who was a few metres in, but he was running back, leapt up in the air and plucked it out of thin air with his right hand, landing a foot inside the ropes!
short of a length on middle, goes for an extravagant pull, but it trickles down to midwicket
full on leg, played away off the backfoot towards square leg

it's that kind of day for Bangalore here! Kohli hit that one straight to midwicket, where Mishra mis-fielded. Bangalore decided to run the second one, Mishra recouped and threw straight to Nannes who removed the bails. Out by miles
stays back and makes room to get the ball from leg stump, down to third man
whipped away nicely off middle and leg, down to long on

Crucial boundary! Kohli moves away to the leg side and made it very difficult for himself, the ball was full and very wide outside off, he somehow got it inches over covers out-stretched fingers for four
full and homing in on middle and leg, he squeezes it away into the leg side and the scamper two.
fulltoss on leg stump, Kohli moves to the legside and looks to bunt it straight down the ground, but can only get a single to retain strike
full outside off, Vinay gets forward and plays it away towards the covers. Over to Kohli.
slips down the leg for a wide.
another short ball, and Boucher has pulled it straight down Sehwag's throat at midwicket! Sangwan's struck another big blow and there will be no Boucher heroics today.
shorter this time, he pulls but can't get it away
nice yorker on leg stump, can't do anything with that
short of a length, stays back and works it away. Boucher is off the mark and they need some magic from him today.

Quick Gun Morgan is gone! Slower ball on leg stump, Morgan works it down to midwicket and runs hard for the second, the throw from AB de Villiers was inch-perfect, Karthik collected it and in his glee uprooted all three stumps. Bangalore are going down!
gets it down to midwicket for one
run-out chance, but the throw misses. Morgan tips it down to point and runs across, the throw misses and he was running a tad casually. Would have been out
lands it this time, Kohli stays back and runs it off the face to turn the strike over
that helps! Full toss, and Kohli obliged by whipping it through midwicket
and another sweep. Powerfully hit by Morgan from off and middle, very square for four through the offside
lovely googly, and again beats both Kohli and Karthik. Kohli missed the pull and Karthik conceded a run, not collecting it cleanly
gets it away this time for one

ball of the day, but it goes away to the boundary for leg-byes. Beats Kohli all ends up with a leg spinner into the rough, and it was miles away from Kohli's legs, and beat DK who missed the stumping. Could have been out, should have been byes, should not have been leg byes.
looped up googly outside off, Morgan stays back and cuts away. Boundaries needed!
length ball again, outside off, driven into the covers
full on leg, played straight down, misfield from the bowler gives a single
full on off and middle, driven down and it hits the non-striker. Still gets the single
tapped down to point and through for another risky single to get off the mark
tight single, stumps are thrown down by short fine leg but they get through
outside off, short of a length and gets a thickish edge down to third man

that's one reverse-sweep too many, and uncalled for! Uthappa tries to work it down from outside off towards third man, gets some glove and it bobbles up, and Dinesh Karthik was already celebrating, took a moment off to complete the catch, and resumed his celebrations.
fuller outside Morgan's off stump, he sweeps it well down to square leg
short googly, Uthappa plays the sweep-pull but can't time
Morgan mis-times the reverse sweep now. He has a reputation for this shot, but this time can only get one
opens up the offside and goes over mid off this time
tries the reverse-sweep again to the leggie, gets an inside edge on to the boots, but Jerling spots it and says Not Out.
another dot ball to finish the action-packed over. Short of a length, on middle and off, Morgan defends back to the bowler
short of a length, angling across Morgan who defends off the backfoot
and Dravid walks back to the hutch! Short of a length outside off, Dravid worked it away very fine, and returned for a difficult second run, he was caught miles short. Bangalore are wobbling!

and Pandey's gone this time! His shot-selection was a little awry at times today and did him here. Straight length ball, he stayed back instead of getting forward and tried to swipe across the line. He missed, and stumps were in disarray behind him.
works it down the ground to rorate the strike

if I said shot of the day for anything earlier in the day, please scratch that! Uthappa picks up the length ball, goes forward, shows the high elbow and halts the follow through as that ball sails into the stands. Shades of Tendulkar v Kasprowicz from Sharjah circa 1998!
when in doubt, Uthappa sweeps, hard and striaight to the sweeper at deep midwicket
nice bowling this, deceives Uthappa with variations in length, he stays back and plays it away
full on Pandey's legs, he tucks it to midwicket and screams Two, but settles for one
loopy legspinner outside off, Uthappa stays back and works it down to third man
regular service from Uthappa! Walks in like he's still in that innings against Chennai and reverse-sweeps the first ball from outside leg to third man!

and he does him in with the classical wrong 'un! Shades of Mushy in Mishy's bowling! Drew Kallis forward with an inviting pitched-up ball, but the bait was set. It was pulled back ever so slightly, Kallis did not get to the pitch and it turned in to crash on to the stumps.
shortens the length after that punishment, outside off, Pandey tries to cut it away but can't get it through. Expensive over for Delhi, crucial momentum for Bangalore's chase.
but he's picked this slower ball early and whacked the covers off it! Length ball outside off, Pandey said ok, I'll take it from here, dropped down on a knee and drop-kicked it over midwicket.
nice comeback, with a slow offcutter. Catches Pandey in no-man's land, but he plays it away safely
shot! In the slot for Pandey, who gets forward and launches it straight over McD's head for a classy boundary
straighter this time, played away from the off stump line towards point
length ball sliding down to leg, played away along the ground to long on
good finish to a good over, slips in the googly and catches Pandey unawares. He manages to squeeze it safely down to fine leg, off the inside edge
full on middle and off, Kallis gets to the pitch and punches down the ground
short ball outside off and Pandey does not get much bat on that pull shot.
played down to midwicket for one
similar line, he gets forward and looks to pierce cover but cannot
nice start, looping leggie turning from leg to middle, quietly played by Kallis
but it doesn't. Kallis plays the full delivery away towards cover and gets a single
and he sprays it wide again, well outside off. Has to rebowl that and he'll kick himself if that goes for four.
no timing again, plays it off the back foot towards midwicket
nice line, short of a length on middle and leg, Kallis can't do much with it, so works it down straight for a single
back of a length outside off and expertly cut away by Kallis behind point. Poor fielding by the fielder running across from third man, he lets it slip through
length ball outside off, Pandey can't get the timing as he looks to drive down the ground.
gets it away for an important four to relieve some of the tension. Slightly off target, slipping down leg, Kallis got inside the line and heaved it well, wide of mid on for four
can't pierce cover! Full outside off, Kallis frees his arms and looks to cover drive., but it is straight to the fielder
short again, and Pandey's not connected a single pull shot till now. It's dribbled down to square leg for one
good variation, slips in the slow yorker on leg stump. Almost flummoxes Pandey who lunges forward but does well to wait it out
short outside off, Kallis stayed back and dabbed it down to third man, but could not beat the fielder
short of a length, Pandey pulls out the pull shot, but is late on it. Down ti mid on
beamer! Fulltoss, slipped out of his hand and Kallis did well to get some bat on it. Apologies from Yadav, nice to see. It was unintended
full outside off, Kallis can't time the cover drive and just about makes his ground to beat Warner's through, which misses by a small margin
full on leg stump, Pandey worked it away off his toes to Sehwag at midwicket who misfielded
shortens the length, at 144.6 kph, but Kallis was waiting, he stayed back and guided it expertly down to third man
127.6 kph, Kallis gets forward and punches it well, but straight to mid off
shortens the length, draws him forward and elicits the drive, but he's early on to the shot. Down to mid on
full and just outside off, Pandey tries to play it down to third man but cannot connect
stumps are out of the ground, but at the non-striker's end! Pandey has absolutely smashed that down, and off stump is out of the ground. That deserved more that one, was hit real hard.
short of a length, pushes Pandey back and catches him in an awry position. Gets it down to cover, no runs
yorker on leg stump, at 139.3 kph, Kallis digs it out towards mid on
slips down the leg this time, and Pandey easily glances it down to fine leg
nice comeback, but no luck! Short of a length at 142 kph, Pandey got a bottom edge on the pull and it trickled wide of leg stump down to fine leg
lock stock and two smoking barrels! Full on off stump, Pandey gets forward and drills it down to long off, along the ground, then blows off some smoke and slips it back into the holster. Shot!
this time, even better sense prevails, the drive goes straight to Warner and they decide not to run
short and wide, and the thick bottom edge died down on Karthik
nice comeback, shortens the length and jags it back into Kallis, raps him on the pads, but it was sliding down
shot of a man in form! Full and wide outside off, Kallis gets the front foot across and lets rip a trademark square-drive going down on a knee. Four all the way
slips it well down the offside, wide

full outside off, drived off the front foot down to mid off, and Warner's at it again! Throws down the stumps at the non-striker's, this time Pandey's read the Running for Dummies manual, so grounds his bat

Drama! Great shot from Kallis, and exceptional fielding from Warner at mid off, but horrible running from Pandey! Kallis cover drives it almost through the gap between mid off and cover, before Warner dived and stopped, and fired it down to the striker's end. Pandey was running like a Bollywood hero, in slow motiion, and what's more he was not grounding the bat. The third umpire rules it not out, but he probably deserved to go for that piece of running.,

a case of ball hitting the bat there! 143 kph, short of a length, Pandey was ages late on his shot, whatever it was, it picked a thick outside edge and flew down to third man before you could say Pandey.
short of a length, and again on that uncomfortable line. Pandey stays back and taps it away to the leg side
shortens the length marginally, angles in from off to middle, played away to the offside
nice and pacy! Yorker on middle at 141.9 kph, Kallis brings down the bat at the last instant
good ball, curves away a hint from leg stump, Kallis gets a feather on to his pads
length ball, homing in on off and middle, played down the track
full on Kallis' pads, he plays it nicely off his toes, through midwicket
great bouncer, Kallis is late on the pull and it thuds into the keeper's gloves
a hint fuller this time and Pandey smacks his lips and latches on. Moves forward and drives down, wide of mid off, the fielder got a bit on it to slow it down
140 kph, on a similar line. Pandey stays back and quietly plays it down to square leg
short of a length at good pace, 143.2 kph, and it curves in to Kallis' pads, he works it away easily to square leg
short of a length from over the stumps and jags back sharply into Pandey, who is caught on the hop. It runs down towards point
